channel.title: South Africa - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from South Africa, every source cited.

item.title: Simon Harmer leads South Africa to series win
item.description: Spin bowler Simon Harmer took career-best figures of 6/16 in the final innings to secure a 176-run victory against Australia.

item.title: The Kiffness shows Johannesburg decline
item.description: Musician David Scott shared a video comparing Johannesburg in 2010 to 2026, highlighting infrastructure decay.

item.title: Helen Zille warns Joburg voters against election boycott
item.description: The DA's Johannesburg mayoral candidate urged voters to cast ballots on November 4 to prevent corruption.

item.title: Into the Woods musical opens in Cape Town
item.description: Sondheim's dark fairy tale reimagining features 25 student performers at the Theatre on the Bay.

item.title: ANC targets 90% vote in Limpopo elections
item.description: President Ramaphosa urged Limpopo to deliver over 90% of votes in the November 4 local government elections.
